Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Googled for it, didn't find anything appropriate, so...

Black Cat Ambushes a tapped Arika. Arika Majesties, untaps.

Fatima plays Hidden Lurker.

Can Arika play Obedience on Fatima, or is Fatima not considered the
acting minion?

Obedience:
Only usable when this reacting vampire is about to enter combat with an
acting younger vampire.

Untap the acting vampire, do not tap this reacting vampire, and end the
current action (and combat). The acting vampire cannot attempt the same
action this turn.

As above, but do not untap the acting vampire.

Hidden Lurker:
Only usable by a ready untapped vampire other than the acting minion.
Only usable after a combat between the acting minion you control and a
blocking minion.

Tap this vampire. This vampire enters combat with the blocking minion.
The first round of this new combat, the blocking minion cannot strike.

As above, with an optional press.

--Colin McGuigan

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
Colin McGuigan <maguaSP...@speakeasy.net> wrote in message news:<-c6dnf4TSLB...@speakeasy.net>...

> Googled for it, didn't find anything appropriate, so...
>
> Black Cat Ambushes a tapped Arika. Arika Majesties, untaps.
>
> Fatima plays Hidden Lurker.
>
> Can Arika play Obedience on Fatima, or is Fatima not considered the
> acting minion?

Fatima is not considered the acting minion, merely a minion entering
combat via an action modifier. (For instance, Fatima cannot Freak
Drive after the combat, since she was neither acting nor blocked.)

If you're looking for rule-verification on this, note that 'acting
minion' is defined in the rulebook as 'The minion performing the
current action'; Fatima is not performing the current action (or any
action), and no card text involved declares her as such, so she is
not.

Note that Mask of 1000 Faces is an action modifier that expressly
changes the minion playing the modifier to be the action minion. You
do not, for instance, become an 'acting minion' when you play other
third-party action modifiers like Cloak the Gathering or Hidden Lurker
or Siren's Lure.

Arika cannot therefore play Obedience on Fatima.

(I believe that technically, Black Cat's action would not be
considered to be fully resolved until the Arika-Fatima combat was
over, which would mean you could Art of Memory the Hidden Lurker or
Fatima-used cards back. Is this so, LSJ?)

> --Colin McGuigan

-John Flournoy

a blocking minion is ended by Majesty.
